topics.title: One Helm Value Puts Running EKS Services on a Splunk APM Map
topics.signal: One user running OBI v0.15.2 as a Kubernetes DaemonSet opened this issue on 23 Oct 2026 about Java agent injection into non-root JVMs. It has two comments, one from a contributor and one from the author. This is one thread, and no search volume was found.
